purpose: First-party facts from Brother's 1034DX product page and the shared limited warranty, compared against data/specs/brother-1034dx.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Same PDF as the 1034D; read in data/reviews/brother-1034d
Never names the 1034DX; family values only

facts.note: Spec had 13.5 lb from a blog; Brother says 12.57 lb. Amazon's 16.4 lb is shipping weight.

site.label: Weight
site.juki: 12.57 lb on Brother's page, lighter than the 1034D at 13.45 lb.
site.others: A comparison blog says 13.5 lb; an Amazon listing says 16.4 lb, likely shipping weight.

facts.value: 13.19 x 11.10 x 11.65 in; carton 13 x 16 x 15 in, carton weight 7.62 lb
facts.note: Order not labelled. The 1034D is 11.73 x 10.98 x 13.19, so the DX is lower and wider.

site.label: Work light
site.juki: LED work area. The 1034D has a bulb.
site.others: Owners and a forum poster say the same.

facts.value: Spec table: 2/3/4 thread change Yes. Copy: works with either 3 or 4 threads
facts.note: Brother's DX page contradicts itself, and its 1034D page lists the same row as No. The DX spec-table row may be a data error; do not claim 2-thread stitches.

site.label: Thread counts
site.juki: The spec table says 2/3/4 thread change: Yes; the copy says 3 or 4 threads. The 1034D table says No.
site.others: Reviews and comparison pages describe it as a 3/4 thread serger.

facts.value: Overlock seam width 5.0 to 7.0 mm from the left needle
Standard (on the machine), blindstitch and gathering feet; 4 mini spools of thread, soft cover, CD of instructional videos, standard sewing machine needles

site.label: Feet and box contents
site.juki: Standard, blindstitch and gathering feet, 4 mini spools, soft cover and an instructional CD.
site.others: The same three feet as the 1034D.

facts.value: 1/5/25 year limited serger warranty: 1 year parts, labor and accessories; 5 years electronics (labor excluded); 25 years chassis casting only
facts.spec_value: 25-year limited with free phone support for the life of the machine
facts.note: Same warranty as the 1034D. 'Free phone support for the life of the machine' is not in the PDF.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 1 year parts and labor, 5 years electronics, 25 years chassis casting only. Original buyer from an authorized seller.

facts.value: USD 289.99 new at Brother USA 2026-10-01; refurbished option offered
facts.note: Spec had $235 at Walmart. The 1034D is $319.99 at Brother.

site.label: Price
site.juki: $289.99 new at Brother USA on 2026-10-01. The 1034D is $319.99 there.
site.others: Walmart lists the 1034DX; Sewing Machines Plus does not sell it.
